attempts.summary: Deployed the inventory web application on node2 and node3 (port 8080) and configured node1 as an nginx-based HTTP load balancer (port 80) across both backends, entirely via Ansible run from node4 (the control node, chosen because it was the only node with ansible/ansible-playbook pre-installed). Executed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all four managed nodes, proving changed boot IDs and full post-restart recovery of services, load balancing, and Ansible tooling.
